admission.justification: Location-omitted shorts measuring within bound is proved by the named passing guard case; single-file member of the family.

applicability: Every short form whose detail location does not fit or could not be written.
conditions: Location identity comes from actual recording, not a fabricated desired filename.
A retained exact location and cut hint are not removed for size.
Failed detail recording is represented honestly.
exclusions: No whole-result file was recorded, so the hint cannot name an existing whole-result file.
The retained recorded path and final hint may exceed the 400-token target after other droppable content is removed.
statement: An over-budget recorded location is never cut, substituted, capped or omitted: the cut answer retains it exactly and ends with a hint naming the whole-result file. If the whole result could not be recorded, the answer retains logError with resultKept false and ends with a no-file hint that gives the logging reason. Location and hint remain when the recorded path and its hint cannot fit the 400-token target after other droppable content is removed.
